objective: Demonstrate the system does NOT merely certify successful runs. Each controlled scenario must classify its failure correctly, explain the planner response, keep the forensic record complete, produce a deterministic diagnostic conclusion, and avoid false-positive certification.

scenarios.name: genuine verification failure
scenarios.description: A mutation run on an engine finds surviving mutants (genuine behavioral gap).
scenarios.planner_response: selected task remains; executor runs; failure_kind=verification_failure

scenarios.name: infrastructure failure
scenarios.description: mutmut/pytest cannot execute (process killed, OOM, timeout, missing toolchain).
scenarios.planner_response: task attempted; executor returns infra-failure; no score emitted

scenarios.name: evidence corruption
scenarios.description: mutation-summary.json present but artifact checksum mismatch / missing artifact.

scenarios.name: scope mismatch
scenarios.description: Executor attempts to run a task outside the planner-authorized scope.
scenarios.planner_response: scope enforcement blocks; task not dispatched
scenarios.evidence_basis: C42.30 q9 scope_failures => CERTIFICATION_BLOCKED; executor pipeline scope-safe helpers (G8)

scenarios.name: discovery drift
scenarios.description: Capability mapping declares coverage unreachable by executable surface.
scenarios.planner_response: drift_blocker recorded in plan; certification blocked
scenarios.evidence_basis: C42.29 G12 (Discovery drift blocks certification); C42.30 TestVerdicts::test_discovery_drift_blocks

scenarios.name: stale evidence
scenarios.description: Prior measurement exists but invalidated by source/config drift; not yet replaced.
scenarios.planner_response: component listed in invalidated; fresh measurement required
scenarios.evidence_basis: C42.30 q8 stale_evidence; real-master-scenario diagnostic (pre-execution) showed INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE for credit_card_engine

scenarios.name: insufficient test surface
scenarios.expected_failure_classification: insufficient_test_surface (uncertainty, gates_certification=false for individual, true if no evidence)
scenarios.planner_response: uncertainty recorded; diagnostic recommends strengthening (not score chasing)
scenarios.diagnostic_verdict: INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE (if no prior evidence) or CERTIFIABLE (if reused with gap noted)

scenarios.name: ambiguous survivor
scenarios.planner_response: strengthening REFUSES Class-E with human-review reason; no test proposed
scenarios.diagnostic_verdict: CERTIFIABLE if uncertainty gates_certification=false; escalation recorded

scenarios.name: cross-component dependency
scenarios.description: Change to shared infrastructure (core_domain_money) should expand invalidation to dependent engines.
scenarios.expected_failure_classification: source_drift on shared infra -> dependent component invalidation
scenarios.planner_response: broader scope than single engine (cross-engine impact)
scenarios.diagnostic_verdict: INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE until all dependent components re-measured
scenarios.evidence_basis: cross-engine-impact.json gap (shared infrastructure propagation NOT yet automated); regression scenario NOT_VERIFIED

scenarios.name: certification blocker
scenarios.description: Multiple gating failures (verification failure + drift blocker) present simultaneously.
scenarios.evidence_basis: C42.30 q9 precedence: ver_failures > drift_blockers > scope_failures; TestVerdicts suite

false_positive_guarantees: No scenario produces CERTIFIABLE when any verification_failure/evidence_failure/scope_failure/drift_blocker is present
INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE is returned when evidence is missing or stale
Genuine verification failure (survivors) yields NOT_CERTIFIABLE, never green
Equivalent mutants (Class B) are refused, never inflated into score
Infrastructure failures emit no score (never 0% fake)

validation_status.gap_detail: FI-9 cross-component dependency relies on shared-infrastructure invalidation which is identified as a gap in cross-engine-impact.json (NOT automated). The single-engine change path (FI-1..FI-8, FI-10) is fully validated.

next_action: Close the FI-9 gap by implementing shared-infrastructure invalidation (see cross-engine-impact.json recommendations) before claiming full cross-engine safety.
